merges.canonical: Saheed Rendo Majhi Medical College and Hospital, Bhawanipatna (Kalahandi)
aliases: Saheed Rendo Majhi Medical College and Hospital (GMC Bhawanipatna), Kalahandi
merges.reason: Two records for the single government medical college at Bhawanipatna, the district headquarters of Kalahandi. Identical institution name; one record stores the town as the city and the district in brackets, the other reverses it and keeps the old name 'GMC Bhawanipatna'. Both map to the same NMC row 'Government Medical College Bhawanipatna'. Canonical name keeps both the town and the district.
